items.title: Phantom Blade Zero launches on GeForce NOW as Nvidia adds nine games
items.summary: Nvidia says Phantom Blade Zero is now on GeForce NOW, alongside nine new games, mod support for Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3, and an upcoming WoW reward.
items.content:
Nvidia says Phantom Blade Zero is now on GeForce NOW, alongside nine new games, mod support for Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3, and an upcoming WoW reward.

Nvidia said S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero has launched on GeForce NOW, adding the martial arts action game to its cloud lineup on Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026. The company also said nine games are joining the service this week, while new mod support is now available for Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered .

In its GFN Thursday post published Oct. 29, 2026, Nvidia described Phantom Blade Zero as a “kungfupunk” action game built around wuxia storytelling, cinematic combat and Unreal Engine 5. The company said players control Soul, a warrior framed for his master’s murder who has 66 days to uncover a conspiracy threatening the martial world. Nvidia said Ultimate members can play the title across PCs, Macs, handhelds, mobile devices, browsers and compatible TVs, with GeForce NOW handling downloads and storage.

The announcement adds cloud availability to a game that had already been scheduled for release on PlayStation 5 and PC. PlayStation support materials dated Oct. 27, 2026, said the game would launch on Oct. 28 in the United States, while PlayStation’s broader background materials describe it as a single-player action title that emphasizes fast melee combat, weapon-based systems and Phantom Edges. Those details provide context for Nvidia’s launch notice, but the company’s post did not provide separate sales or player data.

Nvidia also said World of Warcraft: Forever will arrive on GeForce NOW on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026, at 3 p.m. PT, with a launch-week reward for eligible members available through Wednesday, Nov. 11, at 11:59 p.m. PT. The reward is described as available across GeForce NOW membership tiers for new WoW users who do not already have a subscription, while supplies last and on a first-come, first-served basis.

Separately, Nvidia said mod.io support is now available directly in game for Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered . The post also said an option to sign up for four-month Performance and Ultimate memberships is launching in India on Friday, Oct. 30, 2026. Nvidia noted that GeForce NOW availability for announced titles may vary because games are onboarded after their store releases and added throughout the week.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 lead wanted 2.5 update to be "more meaningful" than CDPR's last Edgerunners patch
items.content:
Gaming Cyberpunk 2077 lead wanted 2.5 update to be "more meaningful" than CDPR's last Edgerunners patch GamesRadar+ Follow Anna Koselke Wed, October 28, 2026 at 11:54 AM UTC Wed, October 28, 2026 at 11:54 AM UTC When you buy through links on our articles, Future and its syndication partners may earn a commission.

Cyberpunk 2077 just saw the release of update 2.5 , a patch that accompanied the Edgerunners 2 debut on Netflix – and one that CD Projekt Red hoped would be very special.

Paweł Sasko, who is now working as Cyberpunk 2 associate director, reveals as much in an entry on the studio's official blog , explaining that the developers wanted the connection between all of Cyberpunk's media to feel "consistent" – which, yes, means Edgerunners and Cyberpunk 2077, as it "has always worked best when you can feel it's one consistent universe, a nexus of stories told from different perspectives."

He continues, referencing characters from both the RPG and its animated Netflix series: "V, Johnny, David, Lucy, the characters from our comics and now the new crew from Edgerunners 2 all experience the same world, but they see something different in it. I wanted the game to acknowledge that connection directly."

Not only that, but CD Projekt Red – and especially Sasko – wanted that acknowledgement to be great .

So great, in fact, that it (in the form of update 2.5, of course) would outshine the patch that accompanied the first season of Edgerunners four years back. In Sasko's own words, "I wanted to create an update for the game that will be much more meaningful than the one we created for Edgerunners in 2022." That "one," as he says, was 1.6 – a patch aptly dubbed the Edgerunners Update, adding transmogs, cross-progression, and more.

This time around, update 2.5 has brought a new quest to the RPG that acts as a prequel to Edgerunners 2. "Players will unlock a new quest that takes place before the events of the show, following the last job of Team King. It introduces King, Meshuga, Miguel, and Emily, and takes players into a part of Night City they have never properly explored before," Sasko describes – and, again, consistency between the show and game was key.

"From the beginning, believability and immersion were the most important for me. If these characters exist both in the game and in the show, they should feel like the same people," as he concludes. "That is why it was incredibly important to get the same voice actors from Edgerunners 2 into Cyberpunk 2077." And so they did just that – and I'd argue that it's worked out quite nicely for CD Projekt Red, too.

Following Edgerunners 2 and update 2.5, the RPG did hit its highest Steam player count in three years , after all. It serves as a testament to the ever-growing quality of Cyberpunk 2077, I'd say, and, yes, how good the collaborative patch has been this time around.

CD Projekt Red just can't stop updating Cyberpunk 2077: "This world keeps giving us reasons to return to it."

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 sequel appears to confirm addition of multiplayer
items.content:
Cyberpunk 2 might finally add the multiplayer component the first game was missing.

Cyberpunk 2077 turned out to be one of CD Projekt RED’s best games, but based on what we know of the sequel so far, it’s going to be outshone pretty quickly.

While we’re not expecting to see Cyberpunk 2 for many, many years, we are hearing some new details on it from CD Projekt RED devs, like how modders are helping develop the game.

Now it sounds like multiplayer is being considered for the sequel, which is music to our ears considering it was a sorely missed aspect of the first game.

As spotted by CheatHappens , CD Projekt RED is on the lookout for someone with an “understanding of multiplayer network architecture and client-server.”

Maybe the studio should hire some of the fans who’ve been working on the Cyberpunk 2077 multiplayer mod if they haven’t already…

Obviously this isn’t direct confirmation that Cyberpunk 2 will support multiplayer, but what else could it be referring to?

The real question is what kind of multiplayer could we be looking at for the next game. A GTA: Online -style experience would be cool, but Grand Theft Auto VI will be hard to beat on that front.

Alternatively, it could go the route of the Destiny games and have a mixture of PvP and PvE. Players could form their own crews and do heists with each other, before taking on rivals in arena-style confrontations.

If multiplayer is included in the next game, it’ll almost certainly be standalone as opposed to something attached to the story.

READ NEXT: I played Cyberpunk 2077 for free in my browser with a budget laptop

Prior to Cyberpunk 2077’s launch, CD Projekt RED intended to include a multiplayer mode in the months that followed, but the idea was ultimately scrapped.

Like GTA: Online, it would have been a separate experience to the base game, so you would probably have been able to create a brand-new character.

You’d then explore Night City at your own pace with either friends or random players, with missions to undertake as you roam around.

Cyberpunk's Edgerunners 2 Update Isn't In The Best State On Switch 2 Right Now
items.content:
Last week, Cyberpunk 2077 celebrated the release of the new season of Edgerunners on Netflix with the reveal of a brand new game update.

The Edgerunners 2 update is now officially live on the Switch 2, but unfortunately, it's not got off to the best start. Players on this hybrid platform are reporting multiple problems, including game crashes, loading bugs, performance issues , and profile & save glitches. Some Night City residents are even claiming the Nintendo version is "unplayable" after the 2.5 update .

We've had a look at the latest update and can confirm there are some bugs, including crashes. The good news is CD Projekt Red is normally quick to respond to these kinds of teething issues. And hey, CP2077 has quite the history when it comes to buggy launches, so it's likely already investigating these player reports & will resolve any major issues ASAP with a patch.

If we get an official response or hear anything about a hotfix, we'll provide an update. And if you haven't already seen what's included in this latest game update, it adds mod support, dual-wielding for pistols, and much more. You can find out about it in our previous post . We'll also take this opportunity to remind you that this release is still a remarkable port for the Switch 2 .

One of the more memorable characters is Weak Kingsley, a well-built mercenary, and after someone managed to replicate his stats in Cyberpunk 2077 , it's clear he's just a tad overpowered.

A former hotshot in the dystopian metropolis, Weak was eventually knocked off the food chain of violence and became a Solo who exists on the fringes. Regardless, he's managed to keep himself well-equipped, no easy feat considering most of his body is cyberware.

The YouTuber KhrazeGaming decided to explore what Weak is actually bringing to the table by piecing together his full loadout from when he was at the peak of his powers. Spoilers: things go a little too well.

Watch On Weak's main weapon is a special revolver that unleashes lightning with each bullet. This gun, called Coronation, is a highly upgraded version of the Burya, using multiple mods to create the desired firepower.

You sacrifice some overall damage, but the combination of bullets and electricity you can chain between enemies more than makes up for it. Khraze points out in his video that once you get the hang of the exact amount of charge you need, you'll see lightning bounce across groups of adversaries in a glorious display of destruction.

The video outlines the specifics of the Cyberware and such that help tie everything together. The result is ludicrous. Quite literally barreling through enemies like they're nothing. items.title: From the Anime to the Game — Free Update Brings Edgerunners 2 Content and More to Cyberpunk 2077!
items.summary: The free Edgerunners 2 Update to Cyberpunk 2077 is available now, with content inspired by the second installment of the hit anime series now streaming on Netflix
items.content:
“Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2” premiered on Netflix on October 20, bringing a whole new cast of characters to Night City for a dark, gritty ride. And now we’re bringing a little piece of that story into Cyberpunk 2077 , too! The free Edgerunners 2 Update is here, with content inspired by the anime, new ways to fight, more customization options, and plenty of other additions.

We’ve got a lot to cover, so let’s get into it. And don’t worry if you haven’t watched the new anime yet — no “Edgerunners 2” spoilers ahead!

One of the things we love about Night City is that there’s always another story unfolding somewhere. V may be central to the events of Cyberpunk 2077 , but they’re hardly the only merc in town, fighting to survive and make a name for themselves on those neon-soaked streets. Every fixer has clients, every crew has gigs to take care of, every Night City merc has their story — and sometimes, those stories collide in unexpected ways.

That’s exactly what happens in the brand-new quest introduced with the “Edgerunners 2” Update. What begins as just another gig from Wakako turns into an action-packed, high-stakes mission that sees V cross paths with Weak Kingsley, a famed Night City merc and one of the main characters of “Edgerunners 2.” We won’t spoil what happens, but during the course of this mission, V has a chance to assist Weak and his crew during a risky gig that takes place in a brand-new location: Night City Prison.

The new “Edgerunners 2” gig is more than a chance to encounter characters from the anime in the game — it serves as a prequel to the events of the series. So, play the quest before watching the anime, and you’ll have a little extra context going into Episode 1. Already seen the show? Then with this gig, you’ll get to revisit part of Weak’s story with a broader perspective of him and his crew.

And there’s even more forEdgerunnersfans in this update. For starters, you can find and equip Weak’s full outfit — vest, glasses, coat, pants, the works — and get your hands on his signature revolver, Coronation. We’ve also added a new radio station, HKGN 102.FM, featuring official tracks from both “Cyberpunk: Edgerunners” and “Edgerunners 2.” So if you’re planning to spend a few more hours cruising around Night City after watching the show, we’ve got your soundtrack covered.

What’s better than blasting your way through a warehouse full of gangoons with a revolver, dealing one headshot after another? Doing it with two revolvers, obviously.

That’s right — dual wielding is here! With the Edgerunners 2 Update, you can raise hell with a pistol or revolver in each hand. That’s a whole new vibe — and a whole new level of awesome.

But dual wielding isn’t just about looking cool. It brings a new playstyle and a fresh way to approach combat — in fact, it’s one of the most significant gameplay additions to the game’s combat since Update 2.0 introduced throwing knives. So if you’ve been looking for an excuse to shake up your fighting style, this might just be it.

Cyberware enhances your stats and abilities — but what if it could take your style to the next level, too? That’s where glamdocs come in. These new vendors let you customize the appearance of your cyberware, with 40 styles in different colors to choose from. Fancy a new look for your chrome? Pay them a visit at one (or all) of the five locations across Night City and see what catches your eye.

In a city that lives and dies by appearances, V really can’t afford to pass up any opportunity to shake up their look. On top of cyberware customization, we’ve also added 20 new hairstyles and several clothing sets to give your V the best chance of standing out, even in Night City.

We know how creative the Cyberpunk 2077 community can be, and we’re always curious to see what players come up with. That’s why we’re introducing cross-platform mod support through mod.io integration.

The update adds a Mods panel where you can browse and install supported community-created content directly in the game. It’s a new way to experiment with your experience, and we’re looking forward to seeing how it develops as more mods become available and receive support over time!

We’ve covered some of the bigger additions, but there’s still plenty to find in the Edgerunners 2 Update.

items.content:
Thought you were done with Night City? Well, Night City's not quite done with you!

Patch notes for Cyberpunk 2077's Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) are now available for your early perusal before the update hits the streets on October 22nd. Watch the Features Overview video to see some of the new features in action:

And if you want to know even more, read through the list of most important changes below:

Edgerunners Content

  • Added a new side quest, Clampdown, set before the events of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. To unlock it, complete The Heist and two gigs for Wakako, then wait for a message from her.

    [/*]

  • Added a new 5-piece gear set based on the character King, which can be obtained during the Clampdown side quest.

    [/*]

  • Added a new radio station, HKGN 102.0 FM, featuring a selection of tracks from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners series.

    [/*]

Show Off

  • A brand-new clothing collection has arrived in Night City! 5 new outfit sets can now be purchased from certain clothing vendors:

    • Maxiwear: available in Heywood, Arroyo, Little China

      [/*]

    • Jinguji: available in City Center

      [/*]

    • NetWatch: available in Kabuki, Japantown

      [/*]

    • IconAmerica: available in Pacifica, Badlands, Northside

      [/*]

    • And one more set that will hit Night City shelves just a little later...

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • The NUS Infiltrator clothing set can be now purchased from clothing vendors in Kabuki and Japantown.

    [/*]

  • 4 new TWINTONE skins for Quadra Turbo-R V-Tech are now available via Twitch Drops.

    [/*]

  • Some of the hairstyles that were previously exclusive to NPCs are now available for V. Please note that some hairstyles are available only to feminine or masculine body types.

    [/*]

  • Show off your chrome! You can now customize your hand cyberware. Equip your Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire or Projectile Launch System, and visit one of 5 Glamdocs (marked with a spray paint icon on the map) to give your implants a fresh, new look. Each Glamdoc is located in a unique shop, along with their own intro scene with voiceover and animations, and offers a unique catalog of cyberware skins with customizable colors.

    [/*]

  • Sometimes one gun just isn't enough. The new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree (along with four auxiliary perks) introduces an entirely new playstyle, allowing you to dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category.

    [/*]

  • Added frames from the Cyberpunk Trading Card Game to Photo Mode, allowing you to make your preem shots look like custom cards.

    [/*]

  • Added new poses in Photo Mode to show off your dual-wielding prowess.

    [/*]

Mod the World

Added Cross-Platform Mod Support, powered by mod.io, a first step into cross-platform modding that allows you to easily browse and install a selection of player-created mods directly from the in-game menu. More mods will become available over time. The feature is available on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S.

Upgrading the World

  • Welcome to Paradise! Added a new side quest that takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night. It unlocks after completing The Heist and reaching level 15 Street Cred.

    [/*]

  • Added 12 new Minor Arcana Tarot Cards to discover across Night City. The Tarot menu now has separate sections for Major and Minor Arcana. The new tarot cards are part of a new side quest, an extension of Fool on the Hill, which activates after scanning any of the new cards. Collect them all to get a special reward.

    [/*]

Quality of Life

  • Saves in the “Load Game” menu are now grouped by separate playthroughs.

    [/*]

  • Added item filters to apartment and vehicle stashes.

    [/*]

  • Modded saves in the "Load Game" menu are now marked with a dedicated icon. Please note that achievements and trophies cannot be earned while playing on console from a modded save file.

    [/*]

  • Updated the selection of AMD FSR options. FSR 3 upscaling is no longer included, while FSR 2.1, FSR 4, and FSR 3.1 Frame Generation remain available.

    [/*]

  • Updated the CD PROJEKT RED Account connection, My Rewards and telemetry consent menus.

    [/*]

Technology

  • Added support for DLSS 4.5, including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation or Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the 2nd Generation Transformer Model.

    [/*]

  • Added support for glasses-free 3D effects on compatible Samsung Odyssey 3D monitors, along with a Motion Comfort setting that lets you balance 3D depth and viewing comfort.

    [/*]

  • Added support for MetalFX Frame Interpolation on Mac.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle in settings for FSR Anti-Lag 2.

    [/*]

  • Introduced various performance optimizations, including improvements specifically for Ray Tracing.

    [/*]

  • Improved HDR rendering to provide more accurate colors, brightness, and contrast on compatible displays.

    [/*]

Fixes

  • Things Done Changed- Fixed an issue where the Delamain cab could get stuck after crashing into another vehicle, blocking quest progression.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where enabling Film Grain had no effect.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where tagging enemies while scanning could also cause V to crouch or stand up when using certain control schemes.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where controller settings for the Third-Person Camera were missing.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several typos in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added various other fixes for features and content introduced since Patch 2.1.

    [/*]

items.title: The Live-Action Cyberpunk 2077 Movie Won't Retrace the Game's Steps, CD Projekt Confirms
items.summary: CD Projekt Red has finally spoken up about the live-action Cyberpunk 2077 movie. The company said it doesn’t want to do a 1:1 adaptation of the game, instead telling a new story within the same universe.
items.content:
CD Projekt Red has finally spoken up about the live-action Cyberpunk 2077 movie . The company said it doesn’t want to do a 1:1 adaptation of the game, instead telling a new story within the same universe.

"At this point, we can only say that we definitely don't want to make a film adaptation of the game," co-CEO Michał Nowakowski told Polish outlet PAP Biznes , via GamesRadar . "We want to tell a story in the world of Cyberpunk, but it won't be a one-to-one translation of the game's story."

The Cyberpunk movie is being created in partnership with Parmount, now under the Skydance banner after the recent merger . The film will be produced by Lorenzo di Bonaventura, of live-action Transformers fame.

It’ll be interesting to see how far the movie strays from the game, which featured a freelance mercenary called V who put a mysterious computer chip in their brain and ended up haunted by the digital ghost of Keanu Reeves’ Johnny Silverhand. I’d personally love them to go back, get Reeves back in, and tell Silverhand’s story before he ended up stuck in a chip.

Of course, the Cyberpunk universe — created by tabletop RPG designer Mike Pondsmith — is wide enough to tell a range of original stories. It’s fertile soil for pulling at themes of identity, autonomy, and the self as a ship of theseus to be modified and reprinted.

It sounds like a similar approach the company took to anime. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners feels like a faithful multimedia project within the world CDPR created — featuring locations and characters from the game world — but it tells a fresh story about original characters in its dystopian posthuman hellscape.

The Studio Trigger-led anime series is back on Netflix this month when Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2 launches on October 20. Check out the IGN interview with the creators of Edgerunners for the lowdown.

CD Projekt also recently announced that work has officially begun on Project Hadar , its first game in its own original universe. The company has previously only played in the worlds of others, with The Witcher based on novels and Cyberpunk based on a tabletop RPG.

Elsewhere in CD Project Land, The Witcher 3 just got a remaster on consoles and PC, which saw the iconic RPG get a makeover. There were some issues with the new visuals, particularly heavy bloom in The Witcher 3 remaster , but CDPR was on the case quickly. And of course, Cyberpunk 2 is in the works, although it feels years away.

Kirk McKeand is a Contributor on IGN News. Find him on Twitter @MckKirk

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 movie adaptation from Paramount on the way
items.summary: The smash hit from the studio behind The Witcher series is to be turned into a film by Paramount Pictures.
items.content:
Image source, CD Projekt Red Image caption, The Cyberpunk 2077 video game featured Keanu Reeves in one of the main roles

A live-action movie version of smash hit video game Cyberpunk 2077 is being developed by Paramount Pictures.

The Hollywood studio is working with producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura, known for his work on the Transformers films, and CD Projekt Red (CDPR), the developer of the sci-fi role-playing game.

CDPR's joint-chief executive Michał Nowakowski said in a statement , external the company was "excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise".

Details of the film's story, potential release date and casting information are yet to be revealed.

Despite a troubled launch in 2020 , the Cyberpunk 2077 video game, which stars Keanu Reeves, has sold more than 40 million copies worldwide.

The John Wick star plays rockstar Johnny Silverhand, a terrorist whose consciousness is stored on a chip inside the body of main character V.

Set in Night City, a fictional metropolis in a dystopian version of California, players work to uncover a conspiracy involving the shady Arasaka megacorporation.

An expansion, Phantom Liberty, starring Idris Elba was released in 2023 and has sold more than 15 million copies, according to CDPR.

Cyberpunk has already been successfully adapted into a popular animated series - Edgerunners - with a second season due to premiere on Netflix later this month.

The streamer also produced The Witcher, an adaptation of CDPR's massively popular fantasy role-playing series.

It originally starred former Superman actor Henry Cavill, but he was replaced by Liam Hemsworth in the show's fourth season.

Image source, CD Projekt Red Image caption, Anime adaptation Cyberpunk: Edgerunners was a big hit with fans

Multiple video game series have been adapted for TV and film in recent years, with more due to follow.

items.content:
To survive in Night City, you need someone to watch your back. On the way to the major leagues, V managed to gather a remarkable crew. You could even say, a crew to remember!

From trusted allies to unforgettable personalities, these are the people who helped shape V’s journey through the City of Dreams. This episode of It’s All About You is dedicated to the legendary crew that stood by V through every high and low.

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk 2077 in the most creative ways possible. Don’t forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY

See you in the next episode!

items.content:
Listen up, Samurai! 🤘🔥

Celebrate five years of Cyberpunk 2077 in this special anniversary episode of It’s All About You, looking back on Night City’s unforgettable stories through the legends and music you met along your journey!

Sure, the city’s full of noise — sirens, synths, gunfire in the distance — but if there’s one song that became its soul, it’s “Never Fade Away.”

We brought together legendary artists from across the city of dreams to reinterpret this iconic track — each in their own voice, their own style, their own rebellion. ❤️‍🔥

Plug in, turn it up, and dive into our latest It’s All About You episode.

Because legends don’t fade.
